tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The ground everything sits on; never put cards on cards to fake depth.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands, the hero's figure stage, code-block gutters.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, the nav when scrolled, mock-window bodies.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons, list rows and interactive cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline: card borders, dividers, section rules, the background grid.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered card borders, secondary-button and input borders.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning (checkbox box, input at rest). Meets 3:1 on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on bg, bg-subtle and surface. Also the fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy and ledes on bg, bg-subtle and surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, placeholder text, mono labels on bg, bg-subtle and surface (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Decoration only: grid dots, disabled glyphs, inactive section indices. Never for readable text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal orange. Focus rings, the one accent CTA per page, active nav marker, live cursor. Use sparingly: one or two touches per viewport.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and links on bg, bg-subtle and surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent badges, selection highlight, hovered accent link background.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (primary button).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: 'Live' / 'Shipped' status dot and text on bg and surface. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: 'In progress' status dot and text on bg and surface. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors: input border and message text on bg and surface. Always paired with a message.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code-block and terminal background. Stays dark in both themes, like a real terminal.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Default code text on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-dim
tokens.usage: Comments, line numbers and prompts on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-key
tokens.usage: Keywords and the $ prompt on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-fn
tokens.usage: Function and component names on code-bg.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page. Drop to 44px under 640px wide.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles on inner pages (a case study, Writing).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles under a SectionHeader index.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, entry titles, sub-sections in a case study.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Software engineer working on developer tools and the parts of the stack nobody sees until they break.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display or h1. ink-soft. Max 36rem wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rewrote the sync layer so edits apply locally first and reconcile in the background.
styles.usage: Default running text, card descriptions. ink-soft.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Form hints, footnotes, secondary card text.
styles.usage: Hints, footers, dense UI. muted or ink-soft.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, section indices, nav links, button text, form labels. Lowercase. muted, or ink when active.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Uppercase metadata: years, stacks, figure captions ('FIG 01'). muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, inline code, terminal mocks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges and kbd.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; label-to-input gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap in card grids; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; button horizontal padding (md).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Background grid pitch; gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Mobile section padding (top and bottom).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Desktop section padding (top and bottom).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, kbd keycaps, inline code, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, entry rows on hover.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large figures: mock windows, hero product shots.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatar only. Not for buttons.

shadow.note: Structure comes from hairlines, not shadows. Two shadows exist: a top highlight that makes dark surfaces read as lit, and one overlay shadow for floating menus.

tokens.name: shadow-highlight
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, mock windows: a 1px top highlight on top of the border.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Command palette, dropdowns, the floating nav after scroll.

layout.note: One centred column with a hairline frame, Vercel-style.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width. Sections draw their side rules at this width.

tokens.name: container-prose
tokens.usage: Max width for case-study and blog prose.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Sticky nav height; scroll-margin for anchored sections.

duration.note: Fast and quiet. Nothing on this site should make a person wait for an animation.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour and border changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Card lifts, arrow nudges, menu open.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Section reveals on scroll (opacity + 8px rise), once only.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for everything that enters or moves.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things that move between two resting places (tab indicator, theme switch).
